senses.gloss:
r. 1st and 10th cls. (वटति वटयति)
1 To surround or encompass.
2 To tie or string, to connect.
3 To partition, to divide.
r. 1st cl. causal form (वटयति)
To speak.
(इ) वटि r. 4th and 10th cls. (वण्ट्यति वण्टयति)
To partition, to separate or divide.

subst. mfn. (-टः-टी-टं)
A string, a rope, a tie.
m. (-टः)
1 The large Indian fig tree, (Ficus Indica.)
2 A round figure, a circle, a cypher, a ball or globe.
3 Pulse ground and fried with oil or butter.
4 A small shell, a cowrie.
5 Equality in shape or dimension.
E.
वट to surround, to tie, aff. अच्.

mfn. adj. (-टः-टी-टं)
Made of the Indian fig tree, of its wood, &c.
subst. (-टः-टी-टं)
1 An enclosure, a piece of enclosed ground, whether a simple enclosure, as a courtyard, or one for trees and plants, as an orchard, a garden, a plantation, &c.
2 A road.
3 A mud wall, a bound hedge or any enclosure of a town or village, &c.
4 A sort of grain, (Panicum spicatum.)
5 The groin.
f. (-टी)
1 The site of a house or building.
2 A house, a dwelling.
3 A plant: see वाट्यालक.
E.
वट to surround, aff. घञ्.

m. (-कः)
1 Pulse ground and fried in oil or butter.
2 A weight of eight Māṣas.
f. (-टिका)
A pill, a bolus.
E.
वट to surround, aff. वुन्.

n. (-कं)
Fried barley.

f. (-त्रा)
A plant, from the fibrous leaves of which bowstrings, &c. are made, (Aletris hyacinthoides: Sanseviera zeylanica, Rox.'s Cata.)
E.
वट a string, पत्र a leaf.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Wicked, villainous.
2 Slippery, unsteady.
m. (-रः)
1 A cock.
2 A thief.
3 A cloth worn round the head, a turban.
4 A mat.
5 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.)
6 A churning stick.
E.
वट to surround, अरच् aff.

mf. (-सी-सिनी)
A sort of demigod, male and female; a YAKṢA or YAKṢIṆĪ, KUVERA'S special attendants.
E.
वट the Indian fig in which these spirits are supposed to be fond of abiding, वास abode, and इनि aff.

m. (-रः)
A cord, a rope, a string.
E.
वट surrounding, आकर what makes, from कृ to make, with आङ् prefix, टच् aff.

m. (-कः)
A notorious thief, a dakoit, a robber.

m. (-टिः)
A sort of tick or body louse.
E.
वट to surround, aff. इन्.

mfn. (-टी-टिनी-टि)
1 Stringed, having a string.
2 Circular, globular.
E.
वट, and इनि aff.

m. (-टुः)
1 The Brahmacārī or religious student, after his investiture with the sacred thread.
2 A lad, a youth in general.
3 A flower, (Bignonia Indica.)
E.
वट to surround, (with the string, &c.) or to speak, उ Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A lad, a young man in general, or one fit to receive the sacrificial thread.
2 A religious student.
3 A stupid fellow, a blockhead.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

n. (-णं)
Investiture with the sacred and characteristic thread.
E.
वटु a lad after investiture, कृ to make, aff. ल्युट्. and the vowel of वटु made long or technically, च्चि augment.

ind.
An exclamation on making an offering of boiled butter.

m. (-नः)
The descendant of an outcast Brahman by a Brahman female.

f. (-ला)
A sort of chain enclosure or fence (?).
E.
वाट an enclosure, and शृङ्खला a chain.

f. (-का)
1 The site of a house.
2 A plant, (Sida cordifolia.)
3 A garden, an orchard.
E.
कन् added to वाटी.

m. (-र्घः)
A sort of grass, commonly Icadā.
E.
वाटी an enclosure, दीर्घ long.

mfn. (-ट्यः-ट्या-ट्यं)
Belonging to a house or garden, &c.
E.
वाटी, यत् aff.

f. (-ट्या)
A plant, (Sida cordifolia.)
E.
वाटी a garden, यत् and टाप् affs.

n. (-ष्पं)
1 Sandal.
2 Saffron.
f. (-ष्पी)
A plant, (Sida cordifolia.)
E.
वाट्य belonging to a house or garden, and पुष्प flower.

mf. (-लः-ली)
A herbaceous shrub, (Sida cordifolia): see the next.

m. (-कः)
A plant, commonly Bariyāla, (Sida cordifolia).
E.
वाटी a garden, in the sixth case, अल to adorn, with अण् aff., and कन् added, the ornament of a garden.
